name: predictdx
description: PredictDx - AI multimodal system for early detection and future risk prediction of chest diseases (FYP, Air University Islamabad)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix backend run setup
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n db,api,web,mobile,ai -c blue,cyan,magenta,green,yellow "npm --prefix backend run db:server" "npm --prefix backend run start:dev" "npm --prefix web run dev" "node mobile/scripts/serve-web.mjs" "node ai-service/start.mjs"
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix backend run test:e2e
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix web run build
